{"arguments": {"content": "import sys
import openpyxl

in_path, out_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(in_path)
ws = wb.active

# Desired results in column C: every nth row from column A.
# Pattern: C2 = A25, C3 = A41, C4 = A57, C5 = A73, C6 = A89  (step of 16, starting at row 25)
for i, src_row in enumerate(range(25, 25 + 16 * 5, 16)):
    ws.cell(row=2 + i, column=3).value = f"=A{src_row}"

wb.save(out_path)
print("saved", out_path)", "path": "/bench/answers/48080/solution.py"}, "name": "write"}
